subject: Early-warning: performance support trajectory launch for Ethan Park
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.com>, David Kim <david_kim@redwood.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com
Date: 2027-05-18T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Early-warning: performance support trajectory launch for Ethan Park

Hi Jasmine / David,

I'm writing to request HR + Legal support to initiate a formal performance support trajectory for Ethan Park (IC, Platform). Over the past two quarters I've documented multiple missed SLAs for the payment routing work and inconsistent PR quality; I attached a short metrics export (q1-metrics.pdf) showing missed delivery and post-release bug rate.

High-level ask: can HR provide the current PIP template and confirm whether a 60-day cadence is appropriate here? I want Legal to review draft language to ensure we avoid phrasing that could be interpreted as disciplinary/termination intent; the objective is to give a clear, evidence-based path to remediation with coaching.

Proposed next steps:
- HR: send template and checklist I should complete (goals, evidence, meeting cadence, mitigation if no progress)
- Legal: quick read of any template changes + flag risky wording
- Leadership (cc'd Laura): visibility and sign-off before manager-employee meeting

I can share the PR notes and a proposed objective list once you confirm. I'm planning to meet with Ethan to align expectations if we have an approved draft.

Thanks,
Jordan
Jordan Blake
Senior Manager, Platform
Redwood Inference

Attachment: q1-metrics.pdf (summary export)

From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
Cc: David Kim <david_kim@redwood.com>, laura_bennett@redwood.com
Date: 2027-05-18T13:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Early-warning: performance support trajectory launch for Ethan Park

Jordan,

Thanks for the heads-up and for attaching the metrics. I've attached the latest HR PIP template (hr-pip-template_v2.docx) — it includes the standard structure we use (objectives, success metrics, check-in cadence, escalation path). For a case with delivery + quality gaps I typically recommend a 60-day plan with weekly 1:1 check-ins for the first 30 days, then biweekly.

Two quick asks before we loop the employee in:
1) Populate the objectives with measurable targets (e.g., PR merge rate, bug escape rate threshold, critical ticket SLAs)
2) Evidence list — link to specific PRs/incidents and the remediation history

If you'd like I can take a first pass on converting your bullets into the template and share an HR-reviewed draft for Legal. Also recommended: schedule a separate prep call with HR (15–20m) so we align on coaching tone.

-Jasmine
Jasmine Liu
People Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachment: hr-pip-template_v2.docx

From: David Kim <david_kim@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>, Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com
Date: 2027-05-19T10:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Early-warning: performance support trajectory launch for Ethan Park

Jordan / Jasmine —

On Wed, May 18, 2027 at 1:45 PM Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.com> wrote:
> Jordan,
>
> Thanks for the heads-up...

Thanks for sending this along. I reviewed the template and HR approach. A few legal pointers:
- Avoid statements that imply a predetermined adverse outcome ("final warning", "will be terminated if" etc.). Keep it framed as "support plan with clear success criteria".
- Remove any evaluative language about intent (e.g., "lack of effort"); stick to observable facts and examples.
- For documentation: keep copies of meeting notes and written acknowledgements; store in the secure HR folder.

I've attached quick notes (legal_review_notes.txt) with line-item suggestions. If you want, we can do a 20-minute legal quick review after HR produces the draft to do a final pass.

-David
David Kim
Associate General Counsel
Redwood Inference

Attachment: legal_review_notes.txt

From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.com>, David Kim <david_kim@redwood.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com
Date: 2027-05-19T16:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Early-warning: performance support trajectory launch for Ethan Park

Hi all —

Appreciate the quick turnaround. I've drafted a PIP based on the template and David's notes; pasted below is the executive summary and the three measurable objectives. Full draft attached (pip-draft-ethan_park.docx). Please review for sign-off.

--- PIP Executive summary (draft) ---
Purpose: Provide an evidence-based 60-day performance support trajectory for Ethan Park to improve delivery reliability and code quality, with coaching and measurable objectives.
Timeline: 60 days (weekly check-ins first 30 days, then bi-weekly).
Objectives:
1) Delivery predictability: Reduce missed delivery instances for assigned sprint work to <= 1 critical miss per sprint across next 60 days (measured via sprint board & delivery spreadsheet).
2) PR quality: Achieve a post-merge bug escape rate <= 2% for code authored by Ethan across the 60-day window; require 1:1 reviews for high-risk PRs until threshold met.
3) Communication & triage: Respond to on-call/triage pages within documented SLA (30 minutes for P1, 2 hours for P2) and demonstrate improved handoff notes in PR descriptions.

Manager commitments: provide weekly focused coaching sessions, pairing on two high-risk PRs per week for first 30 days, and tangible examples for expected PR notes.

If HR and Legal sign off I'll schedule a 30-minute alignment meeting with Ethan tomorrow afternoon to present the plan and capture his questions.

Thanks,
Jordan

Attachment: pip-draft-ethan_park.docx

From: laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>, Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.com>, David Kim <david_kim@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-20T09:00:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Early-warning: performance support trajectory launch for Ethan Park

Thanks Jordan — this looks reasonable and appropriately focused. I reviewed the executive summary and the objectives; happy to green-light the draft with two small adjustments:

1) Add an explicit "coaching logs" section in the appendices where manager notes are stored (HR to confirm secure location).
2) Include a mid-point calibration step (Day 30) where manager+HR+employee meet briefly to review progress and adjust expectations if necessary.

Please add the coaching logs item and schedule the Day 30 calibration check. I support moving forward with the alignment meeting — I won't attend but appreciate being looped on the calendar invite.

-Laura
Laura Bennett
VP, Engineering Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachment: calendar-invite-ethan-pip.ics

From: Ethan Park <ethan_park@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>, Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com, david_kim@redwood.com
Date: 2027-05-20T11:15:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Early-warning: performance support trajectory launch for Ethan Park

Hi Jordan / Jasmine,

Thanks for the note and for sharing the draft. I appreciate the clarity and the opportunity to work on concrete, measurable items. I have two quick questions before the alignment meeting:
1) For the PR quality objective, can you point to 2–3 past PRs you consider the right examples of "expected" PR notes so I know the template to follow?
2) For the delivery predictability metric, will the tracker be visible to me or only to manager/HR? I want to make sure I can own the updates.

I'm available for the proposed meeting slot tomorrow at 3pm and will join.

Thanks,
Ethan Park
Software Engineer, Redwood Inference
